name: Nabanita
reason: Bengali form of navanītā (fresh butter, tender); IAST and Devanagari agree.

name: Smrutirekha
reason: Odia spelling of smṛtirekhā; sensible compound, scripts agree.

name: Swagatika
reason: svāgatikā from svāgata, welcome; scripts agree.

name: Jonaki
reason: IAST jyotsnākī is not a real form. Jonaki is the Assamese/Bengali word for firefly or moonlit glow, close to jyotsnikā; etymology uncertain.

name: Mridula
reason: mṛdulā, soft and gentle; scripts agree.

name: Meher
reason: Persian mehr, not Sanskrit; IAST mehara is unsupported and the source note confuses it with mihira (sun).

name: Nandana
reason: nandanā, daughter or delighting one; scripts agree.

name: Mathangi
reason: mātaṅgī and मातङ्गी match; Matangi is a used given name.

name: Sivagami
reason: Tamil spelling of śivakāminī; IAST and Devanagari match.
